summary: The gauge and fiber formulas, exact simplex depth, planar cap constants, lattice-to-integral estimates, singleton and line bounds, anchored halfspace bound, parity estimate, support-safe energy estimate, minimal-face reduction, and universal simplex-score bound all check out. Boundary and zero-volume fibers are handled consistently, all strict numerical comparisons are valid, and Grunbaum's centroid halfspace inequality is applied in its stated dimension-30 form.
